sight: white lattice window frost patterns

taste: amazake warm on tongue, sugar-rice fusion

perceptual_details: smell: damp earth, unfurling leaves, rain-washed air
sight: cherry blossom petals (fallen, creating carpet)
touch: cold wind with brief warmth pockets

Discovery of photograph in Reira's drawer
perceptual_details: smell: salt spray from Japan Sea, seaweed, sunscreen
sight: Monte Iwaki haze-silhouetted in distance, sun glitter on water
touch: ocean temperature (cold), sand between toes, sweat

sight: maple leaves crimson (specific cultural beauty marker)

weather_as_character.monte_iwaki_protection: volcano shielding Hirosaki, creating microclimate of intense beauty + severe isolation

weather_as_character.sea_as_boundary: Ajigasawa coast separates child-self from adolescent-self, geography as transition marker

climate_encoded_meanings.cultural_resonance: Buddhist impermanence (yuki = snow = name of Yuki)
climate_encoded_meanings.psychological_function: visual metaphor for emotional blankness, purification, new beginning

temporal_cycling: narrative spans three complete seasonal cycles (1999-2001), each repetition deeper in emotional resonance ('cento volte' thesis confirmed through weather return)
